name: TaxReturnPipelineTracker
tagline: Every return from organizer to IRS acknowledgement – deadlines, extensions, client documents and review in one Power Apps app.
description: A complete tax-season app for accounting firms: dashboard, pipeline board, returns register, deadlines calendar, return form and detail panel with a client-items checklist, extension filing, reminders, preparer/reviewer segregation and e-file rejection handling. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any collection, Dataverse table, SharePoint list or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Allowed status transitions with business rules
Statutory and extended due dates with weekend rule
Bulk extension filing with form per return type
Outstanding client items checklist and chase reminders
Preparer ≠ reviewer segregation and reviewer capacity
Late e-file confirmation and rejection handling
Power Fx outputs and six events
Phone layout with bottom bar, cards, lane picker and agenda
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform libraries, no Fluent UI)
